instructions.name: S_BUFFER_ATOMIC_ADD
instructions.description: Add two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in a scalar buffer surface.

instructions.name: S_BUFFER_ATOMIC_OR_X2

instructions.name: S_BUFFER_ATOMIC_SMIN

instructions.name: S_BUFFER_ATOMIC_SMIN_X2

instructions.name: S_FF0_I32_B64

instructions.name: S_FF1_I32_B32

instructions.name: V_MFMA_I32_16X16X4I8
instructions.description: Multiply the 16x4 matrix in the first input by the 4x16 matrix in the second input and add the 16x16 matrix in the third input using fused multiply add. Store the resulting matrix into vector registers.

instructions.name: V_MFMA_I32_32X32X4I8
instructions.description: Multiply the 32x4 matrix in the first input by the 4x32 matrix in the second input and add the 32x32 matrix in the third input using fused multiply add. Store the resulting matrix into vector registers.

instructions.name: V_MFMA_I32_32X32X8I8
instructions.description: Multiply the 32x8 matrix in the first input by the 8x32 matrix in the second input and add the 32x32 matrix in the third input using fused multiply add. Store the resulting matrix into vector registers.

instructions.name: V_MFMA_I32_4X4X4I8
instructions.description: Multiply the 4x4 matrix in the first input by the 4x4 matrix in the second input and add the 4x4 matrix in the third input using fused multiply add. Store the resulting matrix into vector registers.

instructions.name: V_MQSAD_PK_U16_U8
instructions.description: Perform the V_MSAD_U8 operation four times using different slices of the first array, all entries of the second array and each entry of the third array. Truncate each result to 16 bits, pack the values into a 4-entry array and store the array into a vector register. The first input is an 8-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers, the second input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers and the third input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 16-bit integers.

instructions.name: V_MQSAD_U32_U8
instructions.description: Perform the V_MSAD_U8 operation four times using different slices of the first array, all entries of the second array and each entry of the third array. Pack each 32-bit value into a 4-entry array and store the array into a vector register. The first input is an 8-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers, the second input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers and the third input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 32-bit integers.

instructions.name: V_MSAD_U8
instructions.description: Calculate the sum of absolute differences of elements in two packed 4-component unsigned 8-bit integer inputs, except that elements where the second input (known as the reference input) is zero are not included in the sum. Add an unsigned 32-bit integer value from the third input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_F16
instructions.description: Multiply two floating point inputs and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_F32

instructions.name: V_MUL_F64
instructions.description: Multiply two floating point inputs and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_HI_I32

instructions.name: V_MUL_HI_I32_I24
instructions.description: Multiply two signed 24-bit integer inputs and store the high 32 bits of the result as a signed 32-bit integer into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_HI_U32
instructions.description: Multiply two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs and store the high 32 bits of the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_HI_U32_U24
instructions.description: Multiply two unsigned 24-bit integer inputs and store the high 32 bits of the result as an unsigned 32-bit integer into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_I32_I24
instructions.description: Multiply two signed 24-bit integer inputs and store the result as a signed 32-bit integer into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_LEGACY_F32
instructions.description: Multiply two floating point inputs and store the result into a vector register. Follows DX9 rules where 0.0 times anything produces 0.0 (this differs from other APIs when the other input is infinity or NaN).

instructions.name: V_MUL_LO_U16
instructions.description: Multiply two unsigned 16-bit integer inputs and store the low bits of the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_LO_U32
instructions.description: Multiply two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_MUL_U32_U24
instructions.description: Multiply two unsigned 24-bit integer inputs and store the result as an unsigned 32-bit integer into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_NOT_B32
instructions.description: Calculate bitwise negation on a vector input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_OR3_B32
instructions.description: Calculate the bitwise OR of three vector inputs and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_OR_B32

instructions.name: V_PACK_B32_F16
instructions.description: Pack two half-precision float values into a single 32-bit value and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PERM_B32
instructions.description: Permute a 64-bit value constructed from two vector inputs (most significant bits come from the first input) using a per-lane selector from the third input. The lane selector allows each byte of the result to choose from any of the 8 input bytes, perform sign extension or pad with 0/1 bits. Store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_ADD_F16
instructions.description: Add two packed half-precision float inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_PK_ADD_F32
instructions.description: Add two packed single-precision float inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_PK_ADD_I16
instructions.description: Add two packed signed 16-bit integer inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_PK_ADD_U16
instructions.description: Add two packed unsigned 16-bit integer inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_PK_ASHRREV_I16
instructions.description: Given a packed shift count in the first vector input, calculate the component-wise arithmetic shift right (preserving sign bit) of the second packed vector input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_FMAC_F16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed half-precision float inputs component-wise and accumulate the result into the destination register using fused multiply add.

instructions.name: V_PK_FMA_F16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed half-precision float inputs component-wise and add a third input component-wise using fused multiply add, and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_FMA_F32
instructions.description: Multiply two packed single-precision float inputs component-wise and add a third input component-wise using fused multiply add, and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_LSHLREV_B16
instructions.description: Given a packed shift count in the first vector input, calculate the component-wise logical shift left of the second packed vector input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_LSHRREV_B16
instructions.description: Given a packed shift count in the first vector input, calculate the component-wise logical shift right of the second packed vector input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MAD_I16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed signed 16-bit integer inputs component-wise, add a packed signed 16-bit integer value from a third input component-wise, and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MAD_U16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed unsigned 16-bit integer inputs component-wise, add a packed unsigned 16-bit integer value from a third input component-wise, and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MAX_F16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise maximum of two packed half-precision float inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MAX_I16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise maximum of two packed signed 16-bit integer inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MAX_U16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise maximum of two packed unsigned 16-bit integer inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MIN_F16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise minimum of two packed half-precision float inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MIN_I16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise minimum of two packed signed 16-bit integer inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MIN_U16
instructions.description: Select the component-wise minimum of two packed unsigned 16-bit integer inputs and store the selected values into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MOV_B32
instructions.description: Move data from two vector inputs into two vector registers.

instructions.name: V_PK_MUL_F16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed half-precision float inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MUL_F32
instructions.description: Multiply two packed single-precision float inputs component-wise and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_MUL_LO_U16
instructions.description: Multiply two packed unsigned 16-bit integer inputs component-wise and store the low bits of each resulting component into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_PK_SUB_U16
instructions.description: Subtract the second packed unsigned 16-bit integer input from the first input component-wise and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

Truncate each result to 16 bits, pack the values into a 4-entry array and store the array into a vector register. The first input is an 8-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers, the second input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 8-bit integers and the third input is a 4-entry array of unsigned 16-bit integers.

instructions.name: V_RCP_F16
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the half-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RCP_F32
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the single-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RCP_F64
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the double-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RCP_IFLAG_F32
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the vector float input in a manner suitable for integer division and store the result into a vector register. This opcode is intended for use as part of an integer division macro.

instructions.name: V_READFIRSTLANE_B32
instructions.description: Read the scalar value in the lowest active lane of the input vector register and store it into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_READLANE_B32
instructions.description: Read the scalar value in the specified lane of the first input where the lane select is in the second input. Store the result into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_RNDNE_F16
instructions.description: Round the half-precision float input to the nearest even integer and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RNDNE_F32
instructions.description: Round the single-precision float input to the nearest even integer and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RNDNE_F64
instructions.description: Round the double-precision float input to the nearest even integer and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RSQ_F16
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the square root of the half-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RSQ_F32
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the square root of the single-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_RSQ_F64
instructions.description: Calculate the reciprocal of the square root of the double-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SAD_HI_U8
instructions.description: Calculate the sum of absolute differences of elements in two packed 4-component unsigned 8-bit integer inputs, shift the sum left by 16 bits, add an unsigned 32-bit integer value from the third input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SAD_U16
instructions.description: Calculate the sum of absolute differences of elements in two packed 2-component unsigned 16-bit integer inputs, add an unsigned 32-bit integer value from the third input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SAD_U32
instructions.description: Calculate the absolute difference of two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs, add an unsigned 32-bit integer value from the third input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SAD_U8
instructions.description: Calculate the sum of absolute differences of elements in two packed 4-component unsigned 8-bit integer inputs, add an unsigned 32-bit integer value from the third input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SAT_PK_U8_I16
instructions.description: Given 2 signed 16-bit integer inputs, saturate each input over an unsigned 8-bit integer range, pack the resulting values into a packed 16-bit value and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SCREEN_PARTITION_4SE_B32
instructions.description: 4SE version of LUT instruction for screen partitioning/filtering. This opcode is intended to help accelerate screen partitioning in the 4SE case only. 2SE and 1SE cases use normal ALU instructions.

instructions.name: V_SIN_F16
instructions.description: Calculate the trigonometric sine of a half-precision float value using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register. The operand is calculated by scaling the vector input by 2 PI.

instructions.name: V_SIN_F32
instructions.description: Calculate the trigonometric sine of a single-precision float value using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register. The operand is calculated by scaling the vector input by 2 PI.

instructions.name: V_SQRT_F16
instructions.description: Calculate the square root of the half-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SQRT_F32
instructions.description: Calculate the square root of the single-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SQRT_F64
instructions.description: Calculate the square root of the double-precision float input using IEEE rules and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SUBBREV_CO_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the first unsigned 32-bit integer input from the second input, subtract a bit from the carry-in mask, store the result into a vector register and store the carry-out mask into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_SUBB_CO_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, subtract a bit from the carry-in mask, store the result into a vector register and store the carry-out mask into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_SUBREV_CO_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the first unsigned 32-bit integer input from the second input, store the result into a vector register and store the carry-out mask into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_SUBREV_F16
instructions.description: Subtract the first floating point input from the second input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SUBREV_F32
instructions.description: Subtract the first floating point input from the second input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SUBREV_U16
instructions.description: Subtract the first unsigned 16-bit integer input from the second input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SUBREV_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the first unsigned 32-bit integer input from the second input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SUB_CO_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, store the result into a vector register and store the carry-out mask into a scalar register.

instructions.name: V_SUB_F16
instructions.description: Subtract the second floating point input from the first input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SUB_F32
instructions.description: Subtract the second floating point input from the first input and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_SUB_I16
instructions.description: Subtract the second signed 16-bit integer input from the first input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SUB_I32
instructions.description: Subtract the second signed 32-bit integer input from the first input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SUB_U16
instructions.description: Subtract the second unsigned 16-bit integer input from the first input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SUB_U32
instructions.description: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input and store the result into a vector register. No carry-in or carry-out support.

instructions.name: V_SWAP_B32
instructions.description: Swap the values in two vector registers.

instructions.name: V_TRIG_PREOP_F64
instructions.description: Look up a 53-bit segment of 2/PI using an integer segment select in the second input. Scale the intermediate result by the exponent from the first double-precision float input and store the double-precision float result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_TRUNC_F16
instructions.description: Compute the integer part of a half-precision float input using round toward zero semantics and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_TRUNC_F32
instructions.description: Compute the integer part of a single-precision float input using round toward zero semantics and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_TRUNC_F64
instructions.description: Compute the integer part of a double-precision float input using round toward zero semantics and store the result in floating point format into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_WRITELANE_B32
instructions.description: Write the scalar value in the first input into the specified lane of a vector register where the lane select is in the second input.

instructions.name: V_XAD_U32
instructions.description: Calculate bitwise XOR of the first two vector inputs, then add the third vector input to the intermediate result, then store the final result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_XNOR_B32
instructions.description: Calculate bitwise XNOR on two vector inputs and store the result into a vector register.

instructions.name: V_XOR_B32
instructions.description: Calculate bitwise XOR on two vector inputs and store the result into a vector register.

fields.name: SIMM16
fields.description: 16-bit integer input for opcode. Signedness is determined by opcode.

fields.name: GLC
fields.description: If set, operation is globally coherent.

fields.name: IMM
fields.description: Boolean. Specifies whether OFFSET field specifies a SGPR (false) or an inline constant offset (true).

fields.name: NV
fields.description: If set, operation operates on non-volatile data.

fields.name: OFFSET
fields.description: If IMM = 0 and SOFFSET_EN = 0: Specifies an SGPR address that supplies an UNSIGNED BYTE offset aligned to one DWORD for the memory operation (see enumeration). If IMM = 1: specifies a 21-bit SIGNED BYTE offset aligned to one DWORD.

fields.name: SBASE
fields.description: Bits [6:1] of an aligned pair of SGPRs specifying {size[16], base[48]}, where base and size are in dword units. The low-order bits are in the first SGPR.

fields.name: SOFFSET
fields.description: If SOFFSET_EN = 1: Specifies an SGPR address that supplies an UNSIGNED BYTE offset aligned to one DWORD for the memory operation (see enumeration).

fields.name: SOFFSET_EN
fields.description: If set, SOFFSET field is used.

ENC_VOP1.description: Vector ALU operations with one destination and one source. Instructions in this encoding may be promoted to VOP3 unless otherwise noted. Instructions in this encoding may use SDWA or DPP modes unless otherwise noted.

ENC_VOPC.description: Vector ALU comparison operations with two sources. Instructions in this encoding may be promoted to VOP3 unless otherwise noted. Note that vector compare instructions respect the EXEC mask for computing the result in each thread; if EXEC[laneId] is zero, then the comparison for that thread is not performed and the result of VCC[laneId] is zero.

ENC_VOP2.description: Vector ALU operations with one destination and two sources. Instructions in this encoding may be promoted to VOP3 unless otherwise noted.

ENC_VOP3P.description: Vector ALU operations requiring two or three sources and performing two 16 bit ops in one instruction.

fields.name: CLAMP
fields.description: If set, clamp output to [0.0, 1.0]. Applied after output modifier.

fields.name: NEG
fields.description: If NEG[N] set, take the floating-point negation of the N'th input low opcode. This is applied after absolute value.

fields.name: NEG_HI
fields.description: If NEG_HI[N] set, take the floating-point negation of the N'th input high opcode. This is applied after absolute value.

fields.name: OP_SEL
fields.description: Input modifier for low opcode src0,src1 and src2. If 0 select src[0:15]. If 1 select src[16:31]

fields.name: OP_SEL_HI
fields.description: Input modifier for high opcode src0 and src1. If 0 select src[0:15]. If 1 select src[16:31].

ENC_VOP3.description: Vector ALU operations requiring three sources or modifiers; also some obscure opcodes. Almost all VOP1, VOP2, VOPC and VINTRP opcodes can be promoted to VOP3 to use input and output modifiers.

fields.name: ABS
fields.description: If ABS[N] set, take the floating-point absolute value of the N'th input operand. This is applied before negation.

fields.name: CLAMP
fields.description: If set, clamp output to [0.0, 1.0]. Applied after output modifier.

fields.name: NEG
fields.description: If NEG[N] set, take the floating-point negation of the N'th input operand. This is applied after absolute value.

fields.name: OMOD
fields.description: Output modifier for instruction. Applied before clamping.

fields.name: OP_SEL
fields.description: OP_SEL [0,1,2] to select src0,src1,src2 lower[0:15] or higher order[16:31] bits. OP_SEL[3] to select destination. If 0 select [0:15] If 1 select [16:31].For destination 0 sets higher order bits to zero and [0:15] is result. If 1 result in higher order bits and bits preserved in [0:15].

VOP3_SDST_ENC.description: Vector ALU operations requiring three sources or modifiers; also some obscure opcodes. Almost all VOP1, VOP2, VOPC and VINTRP opcodes can be promoted to VOP3 to use input and output modifiers.

fields.name: CLAMP

fields.name: NEG
fields.description: If NEG[N] set, take the floating-point negation of the N'th input operand. This is applied after absolute value.

fields.name: OMOD
fields.description: Output modifier for instruction. Applied before clamping.

fields.name: BLGP

fields.name: CBSZ

VOPC_INST_LITERAL.description: Vector ALU comparison operations with two sources. Instructions in this encoding may be promoted to VOP3 unless otherwise noted.
